Retrieval-OOS infeasibility is NOT invalid: both forks emit RETRIEVAL_INFEASIBLE_OOS and the sensitivity verdict still emits. Else, on EXCLUSIVE unknown_precision (inclusive is sensitivity-only, gating on it pre-declared invalid): screen_stable = (gold-reincluded gates equal gold-screened gates on all four axes AND selection_reincl == selection_preserved); fork_stable = (fork_reincl == fork_screened on AXIS-G3-NEW); BOUND_ROBUST if screen_stable AND fork_stable, else BOUND_ARTIFACT (subtyped screen_artifact=fork-independent screen flip, fork_artifact=fork flip, both). The G2 one-row margin is screen-invariant analytically (parent-published zero flagged rows on G2; runtime-verified g2_reincl_identical) and lexicon-tested via xgates[G2]. The lexicon co-finding (xgates vector, per-axis cross coverage/resolved-abstention/UP, gold_dependent flag) is mandatory co-evidence shaping the reason and product consequence, not a third label. All three decisions (BOUND_ROBUST, BOUND_ARTIFACT, null-invalid) and every subtype flag are synthetically reachable with no subsumed guard (prereg.md#8.3); BOUND_ROBUST and BOUND_ARTIFACT are both empirically live (G3 UP dilution needs >=2/4 new abstentions; G1 FA needs 2/2 new OOS executes; reincluded retrieval fork genuinely open).
estimated_cost: No model calls, no network, no browser, no third-party packages, no new bank authorship. One deterministic stdlib in-process run over ~500 bound rows + 14 reincluded TEST rows + cross-surface rescoring + pooled retrieval fit (199 cal rows) + nested gate search; seconds of CPU; near-zero marginal cost.
expected_information_gain: One cheap batch decides the Director's sensitivity question. Screened reproduction is disclosed non-evidence (validity leg); NEW evidence is (a) the reincluded-superset gate vector (does any gold gate flip: G3 UP dilution, G1 FA/UP exposure, selection drift), (b) the cross-surface gold-dependence demonstration (does the bound survive without surface gold lexicons), and (c) the reincluded retrieval fork (does TFRAME_DOMINATES_G3 persist under symmetric screen handling). BOUND_ROBUST keeps the conservative shipped abstention boundary with a gold-conditional ceiling and reopens blind-resolver work without promotion; BOUND_ARTIFACT (screen or fork flip) returns the ship/no-ship branch and the retrieval-B requirement to the Director and reopens the resolver architecture question. A second MEASUREMENT_INVALID/BLOCKED retires or parks the family per the mandate stop rule. Every branch changes the claim or product state; no branch rewards PASS volume.
falsifier: H1 (screen-robustness of the published no-refit bound) is SUPPORTED (BOUND_ROBUST side) iff on the gold lexicon the reincluded-superset gate vector equals the screened gate vector at gate level on all four axes (G3 met, G1 met, ALTLEX met, G2 false-solely-on-UP with FA and coverage passing) AND selection_reincl == selection_preserved AND the reincluded G3 fork equals the screened fork (TFRAME_DOMINATES_G3 reproduced first). H1 is FALSIFIED as a screening artifact (BOUND_ARTIFACT, screen_artifact=true) if any gold gate flips screened->reincluded or selection flips. H2 (fork robustness) is FALSIFIED as an artifact (BOUND_ARTIFACT, fork_artifact=true) if fork_reincl != fork_screened. The lexicon asymmetry hypothesis is decided by the mandatory co-finding: gold_dependent=true (every gold-met axis fails under the foreign lexicon) confirms the published fork is gold-lexicon-conditional; any preserved cross gate strengthens lexicon-generality without promoting. Neither H1 nor H2 may be decided on unknown_precision_inclusive (sensitivity only, prereg.md#6); gating on inclusive is pre-declared invalid. Any refit of the deterministic clause set is out of scope per the mandate stop trigger (BLOCKED, new architecture experiment).
